approval: continue, after explicit request to authorize block6
analysis_standing: Post-campaign audit; outcome rates were already known. No new preregistration or independent test claim.

bootstrap.pairing: Same resampled groups for all arms; retain both variants, every seed and every item; repeated group draws keep multiplicity.
bootstrap.semantic_subset: Pre-labelled subset; resample groups represented in that subset, without selecting by output.
bootstrap.no_denominator: Return null, count omitted bootstrap draws explicitly; never impute perfect precision.

wilson.unit: Group entirely correct across both variants and all available seeds; auxiliary stricter diagnostic, not original acceptance target.

errata.K03_false_overlap: Preserve original rejected/not_applicable ambiguity; measure negative-state equivalence only as sensitivity, not new gold.

blind_presentation.action: Shuffle six panel families and mask names/policy/raw/grade; same family label across seeds; mapping separate.
blind_presentation.human_evaluation: Optional, not executed or used to claim usefulness.
